dict.string: Lattice uses Automation to move files, send items to the Trash, open requested commands and control playback in your media apps.
Lattice uses system audio to control app volume, show music waveform, and record Mac sound.
Lattice uses Bluetooth to access your accessory’s battery level.
Lattice records your microphone only when you turn it on for a screen recording. The audio stays on your Mac unless you choose to create a temporary link.
Show your upcoming appointments in the notch. Calendar events stay on this Mac.

Lattice uses your camera when you open camera preview or enable the camera overlay for a recording. Camera video is recorded only when you enable it for a screen recording and stays on your Mac unless you choose to share it.
Lattice accesses files here for download monitoring, file tools, saving captures and reviewing old screenshots in Cleaner.
